skills.description: 自动化将 ArcGIS JS API 4.x widget 命令式工具重构为 5.0 component 声明式组件。 This skill should be used when the user needs to convert, migrate, or replace a deprecated ArcGIS widget (e.g. TimeSlider, Sketch, Search, LayerList, Legend, BasemapToggle, Zoom, Compass, Home, Expand, etc.) with its corresponding arcgis-* web component. Triggers: "convert widget", "replace widget with component", "migrate widget to component", "widget to component", "TimeSlider 替代", "Sketch 替代", "组件化迁移", "widget 转换". This skill is complementary to the arcgis-js-component skill — use it specifically for systematic conversion, not general component development. Unless otherwise specified, use ArcGIS JS SDK 5.0 CDN.
skills.description_zh: 由于 arcgis js 5.0 开始，已经弃用微件（widget），改用组件（component），对于以往的旧代码，手动修改比较耗时耗力。此技能主要用于无缝将微件（widget）转为组件（component），自动调试校验，极大提升开发效率和开发准确度。
skills.name: widget-to-component-converter

skills.description: ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript 5.0 Components (Web Components) 开发辅助。 This skill should be used when the user wants to create or migrate to the component-based approach using arcgis-scene, arcgis-map, arcgis-sketch, and other custom elements. Triggers: "component", "arcgis-scene", "arcgis-sketch", "arcgis-map", "map-components", "web component", "custom element", "migrate to component", "5.0 component", "Sketch widget deprecated", "replace widget with component", "declarative map". Unless otherwise specified, use ArcGIS JS SDK 5.0 CDN.
skills.description_zh: 辅助 arcgis js 组件化开发，由于 5.0 开始，已经弃用微件（widget），改用组件（component），此技能主要帮助开发人员生成基于组件的功能。

skills.description:
判定非计算机专业教师当前的 AI 教学应用能力处于「选→用→配→组→养」五环的哪一环，
并给出通往下一环的"最小可行进阶任务"，逐环陪伴、不跨环硬推。
这是 yrns「AI 教学专家」三维育人成长球中『AI 教学应用能力进阶』轴的单维深诊子技能，
既可被主技能在定位阶段调用，也可独立用于教师 AI 培训中的能力盘点与进阶路径规划。
